record.original_question: A directed graph G is A-connected, for a non-trivial Abelian group A, if for every function b:V→A with ∑_{x∈V} b(x)=0 there exists a function f:E→A\{0} whose boundary ∂f equals b; a graph is almost-A-connected if all such boundaries are admissible except the zero boundary. Is every bicritical snark almost-Z_2^2-connected and almost-Z_4-connected?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let A be a non-trivial finite Abelian group, written additively. For a directed graph G = (V, E) and a function f : E → A, define the boundary ∂f : V → A by
  (∂f)(v) = Σ_{e leaving v} f(e) − Σ_{e entering v} f(e).
A function b : V → A is called balanced if Σ_{x ∈ V} b(x) = 0. The graph G is said to be A-connected if for every balanced function b : V → A there exists f : E → A \ {0} with ∂f = b; the boundaries b that arise this way are called admissible. The graph G is said to be almost-A-connected if every balanced b : V → A except possibly the zero function is admissible (the zero boundary may fail).

A snark is a cyclically 4-edge-connected cubic graph of girth at least 5 whose edges cannot be properly coloured with 3 colours. A snark G is called bicritical if for every pair of distinct vertices u, v of G, the graph G − {u, v} is 3-edge-colourable.

Prove or disprove: every bicritical snark is both almost-(Z_2 × Z_2)-connected and almost-Z_4-connected (with respect to some, equivalently every, orientation of its edges).
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a problem in a recent open-problems collection from the 33rd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings (2024). Web search did not surface any published resolution of the conjecture that every bicritical snark is almost-(Z_2×Z_2)-connected and almost-Z_4-connected. Related results address bicritical snark decompositions and group connectivity of cubic graphs but not this specific statement, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Morphology of small snarks
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses bicritical snarks and their decomposition into cyclically 5-edge-connected bicritical snarks; does not resolve the almost-group-connectivity conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Recent literature on bicritical snarks does not resolve the almost-Z_2^2 and almost-Z_4 connectivity conjecture.

status_evidence.title: On bicritical snarks
status_evidence.snippet: Studies structural properties of bicritical snarks but does not establish almost-group-connectivity for Z_2^2 or Z_4.
status_evidence.claim: No published resolution of the conjecture is found in the bicritical snark literature.
